notes.title: Demo Update 0.6.9
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623041/bc86ca8dc411fc6d62e7989c2024b9ef06c53c75.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi Tavern Keepers![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you very much for the support and the feedback![/p][p][b]Here are the changes for version 0.6.9[/b] :[/p][p][/p][p][i]Please note that in order to get the full experience of the new changes, you may have to start a new game from scratch.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Added[/h2][list][*][p]Added 3 more fish types[/p][/*][*][p]Added French translations for orders[/p][/*][*][p]Added a buff to Chickens when they spend the night in a coop[/p][/*][*][p]Added glow on Chicken Eggs and Apples for better visibility[/p][/*][/list][h2]Changed[/h2][list][*][p]A new speech bubble will replace an existing one on the Villagers (trying to make Twitch messaging more consistent)[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the area around Tavern doors where player can't place items[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixed[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Cows would try to use Chicken Coops at night[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue preventing Chickens from producing eggs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the collider on walls with windows the would not allow placement[/p][/*][*][p]Attempt at fixing an issue with Fruit Crusher not having an active item on reload[/p][/*][*][p]Attempt at fixing an issue where Inventory is not saved correctly[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Remember you can always report bugs, give feedback and talk to me directly on discord![/p][p][url="http://discord.nullmoongames.com" style="button"]Join Evergreen Tavern Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Take care,[/p][p][i]Rom[/i][/p]

notes.title: Demo update 0.6.8
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623041/eaf66cf7f41bbeff47bf35d025840e49fd213753.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello Tavern Keepers![/p][p][/p][p]🇫🇷 Oui oui, la Taverne parle aussi français maintenant !* [/p][p]🍺And some good news for Twitch streamers who can now add their channel name in the settings and should see their chat talking to them as the villagers 🙂[/p][p][/p][p]Here are the changes that came with the new update [b]0.6.8[/b]:[/p][p][i]Please note that in order to get the full experience of the new changes, you may have to start a new game from scratch.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Added[/h2][list][*][p]Players can now enter a Twitch channel name and the chat will be spoken by the villagers (still working on this)[/p][/*][*][p]Added French localization and the ability to switch language from the menu (some translations might be missing)[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixed[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where pressing Q (A on French layout) would leave Rename UI (dogs/tavern/signposts)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Remember you can always report bugs, give feedback and talk to me directly on discord![/p][p][url="http://discord.nullmoongames.com" style="button"]http://discord.nullmoongames.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Take care,[/p][p][i]Rom[/i][/p][p][/p][p]* [i]Yes yes, the tavern also speaks French now![/i][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.6.7
notes.notes: [p]Hello Tavern Keepers![/p][p][/p][p]Here are the changes for this 0.6.7 version:[/p][h2]Changed[/h2][list][*][p]Added the ability to keep E pressed in order to keep serving with Refillable Barrels[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixed[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed issue where Fruit Crusher would not be saved[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where gravity was not applied when casting fishing rod[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Empty Barrels could be refilled infinitely (max is 20)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where items could be placed in water[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collision in part of the Tavern's roof[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I am working on a cool little thing that will be funny for Twitch content creators :)[/p][p][/p][p]As usual, feel free to join Discord and come talk to me![/p][p][url="http://discord.nullmoongames.com" style="button" buttoncolor="#728f31"]http://discord.nullmoongames.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Take care,[/p][p]Rom[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.6.4
notes.notes: [p]Hi Tavern Keepers 🍻🌲,[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for all the feedback on Discord so far! This update aims at fixing the following:[/p][p][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the world space menu would not update when a product was served[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where bought extensions would not be saved[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an ID issue that replaced Fruit Crushers with Refillable Barrels[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where hitting the Esc key to leave Order Menu would also open the pause menu [/p][/*][/list][h2]Known Issues[/h2][list][*][p]It has been reported that the Fishing Rod and the Pond will not stay unlocked at the Merchant after loading a save[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Please note that since the Save System has been updated, your current save will probably not be compatible with this new version![/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you for playing[/b], I have been so glad to receive all the feedback recently 😊[/p][p][/p][p]As always you can reach out to me directly on discord[/p][p][url="http://discord.nullmoongames.com" style="button" buttoncolor="#884513"]Evergreen Tavern Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p][i]Take care,[/i][/p][p][i]Rom[/i][/p]

notes.title: 0.6.1 Hotfix
notes.notes: [p]Hi Tavern Keepers,[/p][p][/p][p]I just pushed a hotfix for the Cooking Pot which was preventing the game from running when placed. Sorry about that.[/p][p][/p][p]Take care![/p][p]Rom[/p]

notes.title: Demo update 0.6
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623041/4f56c946cf95d926586b2beb1999a2b2e22412cf.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi Tavern Keepers![/p][p][/p][p]Finally! FISH ARE HERE 🐟 [/p][p][/p][p]You can unlock the Fishing Rod from leveling, along with the Pond where you can put your lovely friends. Each of them will count towards your Reputation bonus (up to a certain maximum multiplier)[/p][p][/p][p]Here are the changes that came with the new update [b]0.6[/b]:[/p][p][/p][p][i]Please note that in order to get the full experience of the new changes, you may have to start a new game from scratch.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Added[/h2][list][*][p]Added Fishing Rod item, which can be bought at the Merchant at level 7[/p][/*][*][p]Added Pond item, which can be bought at the Merchant at level 7[/p][/*][*][p]Added colliders to water[/p][/*][/list][h2]Changed[/h2][list][*][p]Increased villagers' speed further[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled Cart item for now[/p][/*][*][p]Set max Tavern Level for Demo to 7 instead of 5[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixed[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where a barrel with 1 serving left will spawn drinks even when empty if the interact button is kept pressed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where buying a Fruit Crusher would spawn a Refillable Barrel in the Delivery Zone[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Shield and Sword decoration item would be unlocked twice from leveling[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Known issues[/h2][list][*][p]Lava in Dungeons is rendering with a pink tint[/p][/*][*][p]Cows get stuck after some time and won't move anymore[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Happy fishing![/p][p][/p][p]Remember you can always report bugs, give feedback and talk to me on discord![/p][p][url="http://discord.nullmoongames.com" style="button"]http://discord.nullmoongames.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Take care,[/p][p][i]Rom[/i][/p]

notes.title: Demo update 0.5
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623041/1b780c9a7470e1fcc961c8e0727cc1b63e4f100b.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi Tavern Keepers![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again to all of you for all the incredible support in the past weeks![/p][p][/p][p]Here are the changes that came with the new update [b]0.5[/b]:[/p][p][/p][p][i]Please note that in order to get the full experience of the new changes, it is advised to start a new game from scratch.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Added[/h2][list][*][p]Fences and Crops now snap together when being placed[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item at the Merchant: Chicken Coop. Chickens will go sleep inside a placed Chicken Coop providing there's room (up to 9 chickens per coop)[/p][/*][*][p]Drinks will now be poured from barrels as long as the interact key is being pressed[/p][/*][*][p]Added one more room variant to Dungeons[/p][/*][/list][h2]Changed[/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted chest spawn chances in Dungeons[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance of Dungeons generation[/p][/*][*][p]Reorganized tutorial windows layout[/p][/*][*][p]Added a way for enemies to travel between Dungeon rooms[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixed[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed instances of an issue where enemies would get stuck and then teleport directly to their desired location[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed and adjusted some tutorial information[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Known issues[/h2][list][*][p]Some enemies might still get stuck or behave erratically[/p][/*][*][p]Dungeons still stutter a bit when being generated[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The chicken coop is only the beginning... 🐮🐷🐶[/p][p][/p][p]Remember you can always report bugs, give feedback and talk to me on discord![/p][p][url="http://discord.nullmoongames.com" style="button"]http://discord.nullmoongames.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Take care,[/p][p][i]Rom[/i][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix for Evergreen Tavern Demo 0.4.1 (Cooking Pot)
notes.notes: [p]Hi Tavern Keepers![/p][p][/p][p]Sorry about the Cooking Pot bug, it's fixed with this version.[/p][p][/p][p]Take care.[/p]

notes.title: Demo update 0.4
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623041/de49a629751e9cc535eac6f28a1b4f52fc9bd5f0.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi Tavern Keepers![/p][p][/p][h1]First of all, thank you so much!!!![/h1][p]to everyone who played Evergreen Tavern's demo! It's been so cool seeing y'all play and have fun, getting your feedback and meeting some great people along the way :)[/p][p][/p][p]Here are the changes that came with the new update [b]0.4[/b]:[/p][p][/p][p][i]Please note that in order to get the full experience of the new changes, it is advised to start a new game from scratch.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Added[/h2][list][*][p]Apple seeds can be planted and will grow into Apple Trees[/p][/*][*][p]New item: Fruit Crusher can be bought at the Merchant, use it to crush Apples into juice![/p][/*][*][p]Added a visual list when adding something on the tavern menu with product icons, name and quantities[/p][/*][*][p]Added a button to the Cooking Pot interface allowing to display already discovered recipes and automatically fill the Cooking Pot slots with the required ingredients if in inventory[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to close all menus with the Escape key[/p][/*][/list][h2]Changed[/h2][list][*][p]Doubled speed at which the Water Jug adds water to crops[/p][/*][*][p]Increased speed at which Player moves when crouched[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixed[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a game breaking issue where the Player could sometimes not move anymore after being killed 3 times in the dungeons[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where snow and wind could trigger at the end of every day[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect naming on Apple seeds in order menu and pickable item[/p][/*][/list][h2]Known issues[/h2][list][*][p]The tutorial windows are sometimes inconsistent, some information is missing and some pictures are incorrect[/p][/*][*][p]The enemies in dungeons will sometimes get stuck and directly teleport to their desired destination after some time[/p][/*][*][p]The dungeons can sometimes have very little loot in them[/p][/*][*][p]Some items are hard to place down with precision (especially the flower pots)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I hope you are looking forward to what's coming next, I'm cooking some cool stuff ːlunar2019piginablanketː[/p][p]Take care,[/p][p][i]Rom[/i][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.3.3
notes.notes: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623041/628634ae42319674381dd9ca44d5e9d359c5e2b9.png"][/img][/h1][p][/p][p]Hi Tavern Keepers![/p][p][/p][p]Evergreen Tavern Demo has been updated to version 0.3.3[/p][p]Here's a list of what changed:[/p][h2]Added[/h2][list][*][p]Added UI information about dungeon opening cost and a notification if not enough money[/p][/*][*][p]Added a notification that a customer is waiting at a table after they waited for some time[/p][/*][/list][h2]Changed[/h2][list][*][p]Slightly reduced reputation earnings from serving customers[/p][/*][*][p]Changed obsolete images and texts in Tutorial screens[/p][/*][*][p]Changed pressure plate trigger time[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixed[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where lives were not displayed when in dungeons[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Player would not be spawned back at dungeon portal on death[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where player could still move after taking damage[/p][/*][/list][p]Enjoy and take care :)[/p]
